race.comment: BLONDE SUSPECT (12) failed to stay the trip after finishing midfield at Donald over 2218m last start a fortnight ago. He is much better placed over 1600m, and though his best form has been on the poly track. he meets the right sort of field to break his turf course duck. FONN POWER (1) failed to fire at Mildura last start when hanging out the whole way. He is peaking at the right time, and he has the ability to be competitive in this company. Each way value. DIGARI (2) was solid in the market and performed well when finishing third as the favourite last start at Hamilton. With 2 placings from 3 runs this prep, he looks a genuine each-way threat. Follow your money. TEDDY BOY (8) showed some improvement at Wangaratta on a wet track and he can continue to progress, while VORES (10) fought hard to finish close up in third place at Ballarat-synthetic, and she has each-way claims again.
